plugins.deleteDescription: The package and its settings are removed. It unloads when the server restarts. Content it created stays.
plugins.howBody: Plugins run inside the NodePress server, so only install plugins you trust. The core still limits what they hook into: a plugin can only subscribe to the events its declared permissions allow, a failing hook is logged without breaking the request, each hook has a 5-second timeout, and turning a plugin off stops its hooks, jobs and API routes immediately — no restart. Installing, updating or deleting an uploaded plugin takes effect after a restart; one that breaks startup is switched off automatically.
